description.value:
When Militech goes to war, they don’t play games. Their newest automatic smartguns exemplifies this, boasting high-capacity box magazines and impressive targeting systems. Rumors continue to spread about a large batch of prototypes and schematics of these models being smuggled into Dogtown, for reasons unknown. For owners of a Hercules, you can be a one-choom smart-guided army — for everyone else, good luck ever affording one.

Cost: 7,500eb (Super Luxury)

Class: EQ Machine Gun • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Battle Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 90 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Gun 5), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Auto-Compensator, Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon’s Smart Rebuild does not require an Interface Plug/Subdermal Grip to operate. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it expends 3 rounds and deals 1d6 additional damage (6d6). Reloading this weapon requires two Reload Actions.

Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Auto-Compensator, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 5), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
